info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the withdrawal of submitted career applications. Through this endpoint, users can manage their application status by removing previously submitted applications from consideration. It is particularly useful for job applicants who wish to retract their applications for specific positions. This functionality supports better application management, empowering users to maintain control over their job seeking process.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw their application from the system. Once withdrawn, the application will no longer be processed or reviewed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a withdrawal request. It is expected to conform to the defined schema, ensuring all necessary withdrawal details are provided to successfully process the deletion operation.

200.description: The withdrawal request was processed successfully.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for withdrawing an application. It is expected to contain a string value.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number assigned to the withdrawal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: Current state of the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the withdrawal request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the successful withdrawal of an application.
